draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. Swanand Shembekar passed along your number and suggested I reach out, since you work with automation and robotics in the Automation Technology Group at Applied Materials.

Your work touches collaborative robots, machine vision, and industrial automation, and that overlaps a lot with what I have built on my own, including a full pick and place robotic system, transformer based models, and vision pipelines running on embedded hardware. I am applying to the Machine Learning Engineer, Generative AI role at Applied Materials and thought you might be a good person to talk to given your background there.

If you're open to it, I would really appreciate a referral or just being pointed toward the right team for that role.
draft.hook_used: Mutual connection referral (Swanand Shembekar) + shared technical domain (robotics, machine vision, automation)
